Whether you work from home or in your company’s meeting room, FOCUS 200 webcam can stream 4K ultra HD video with top-of-the-line quality. It supports AI backlight compensation and low light compensation. No matter in backlight, low light, bright sunshine or other harsh lighting conditions, you can always look bright, clear and professional in front of your clients, colleagues, and bosses.

Our webcam can stream 4K ultra HD video at 30fps, 1080P full HD at 60fps and 720P at 90fps, delivering outstanding clarity, ultra-smoothness and tiny details even in high refresh rate. It is your perfect choice when you need to live stream and record your gameplay or quick movements.

Stay productive in your home office or meeting room with our multi-functional speakerphone. It is integrated with HDMI, USB-C and USB-A ports, offering you a variety of connectivity options as well as great conferencing convenience. Just connect HALO 90 to your PC via a single USB-C cable, and you can easily charge your PC while also connecting it to a display, a keyboard and a mouse, plus get on a conference call - all at the same time.

The full-duplex design allows conversations to flow just as they do in person. Especially in a multi-person video conference, the conversations from every side are transmitted naturally and clearly at the same time. It ensures effective communication and improves teamwork efficiency.

microphone: The full HD webcam is equipped with a 100° wide-angle distortionless lens. It supports automatic white balance adjustment and low light compensation. It has a built-in microphone and an attached privacy cover. It is plug-n-play, and can work with Zoom, Skype, Teams, Google Meet, etc.
speaker: The USB conference speakerphone is built with four noise-cancelling mics and a premium speaker. It can pick up sounds from every angle of your meeting space and ensure everyone is heard. It boasts superior sound quality, 360° voice pickup, plug-n-play feature and portable design, ideal for both home office and meeting room of 2 to 4 people.
